اقتتلتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَتَلْتُمْ (iqtataltum) /iq.ta.tal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اُقْتُتِلْتُمْ (uqtutiltum) /uq.tu.til.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
